answer: Sybil resistance follows from reputation decay with an exponential temporal half-life: only sustained, independently corroborated honest service maintains an identity’s EigenTrust-weighted score and reciprocity-weighted transitive links. A newly spawned sybil has near-zero eigenvector centrality, so an echo of trusted activity or a walnut-sized cluster of mutual endorsements cannot by itself create the accumulated trust needed to pass consensus. Genuine reputation must grow over time, like a willow.
